Players Committee card image of [[Ahch-To (Playtest)]] — a '''Playtest''' image: published on 1 August 2019, before Virtual Set 11's official release (2 August 2019), and replaced before release. Uploaded unchanged.

The file is byte for byte (SHA-1 <code>600c77bcf27b61c5194bba1fd1f77ebd441fcd4a</code>) the Players Committee's ''Dagobah'' (Light) errata card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Dagobah-Light/large/dagobah.gif</code>, which has been in the image set since its first commit ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b], 8 July 2018; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive]): on 1 August 2019 the Players Committee put the Dagobah card image under the Ahch-To file name and replaced it the next day. [[Dagobah (Light) (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] shows its own copy, [[:File:Dagobah-L-dagobah-PC-Errata-2018-E-card.gif]].

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/ahchto.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/ahchto.gif] as of commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1” (1 August 2019).

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/68/V11-L-ahchto-20190801.gif Internet Archive item].
